Self-Assessment: Do the dirigeants hold formal meetings at a frequency adequate for the UCI's activity (at least quarterly for open-ended UCIs), covering all key oversight topics (portfolio management, oversight of delegates/IFM, valuation, capital transactions, conflicts of interest, regulatory developments, relationship with depositary)?
Feedback Report §1.2.1 (Formal meetings of the dirigeants of UCIs)

Does the UCI have an effective conflicts of interest policy and procedures in place — taking into account the policies of the appointed IFM where applicable — to identify and manage conflicts of interest entailing a material risk of damage to the UCI or its investors?
Feedback Report §1.2.2 (Conflicts of interest); CSSF Reg. 10-4 Art. 20; CDR 231/2013 Art. 31
For SIFs/SICARs: are procedures in place to verify that all investors — including in closed-ended sub-funds — qualify as well-informed investors?
Feedback Report §1.2.3 (Investors in UCIs, SIFs and SICARs); SIF Law Art. 2; SICAR Law Art. 2
Is there a formalised policy covering the treatment of active and passive investment breaches that may occur at (sub-)fund level?
Feedback Report §2.1 (Treatment of active and passive breaches); Circular CSSF 24/856

Is there a materialised (standardised and/or IT-backed manual or automated) ex-post investment compliance control framework covering all legal, regulatory and contractual investment restrictions applicable to the UCI, including SFDR investment rules?

For UCITS investing in securities under the 'trash ratio' (Article 41(2)(a) UCI Law): are documented pre-trade liquidity analyses and forecasts performed, and compliance verified, before investing in such securities?
Feedback Report §2.3 (Eligibility requirements for investments by UCITS); UCI Law Art. 41(2)(a); CSSF Reg. 10-4 Art. 26
Have the dirigeants formally approved (e.g. board minutes/resolution) the valuation policies and procedures applicable to the UCI, going beyond the mere approval of the prospectus provisions?
Feedback Report §3.1.1 (Formal approval of the valuation policy/procedures)
Is there a formal escalation process to the dirigeants for significant (UCI-specific or market-driven) valuation issues that may impact investors' interests?
Feedback Report §3.1.2 (Escalation process of material valuation issues)
For open-ended UCIs: is the valuation frequency of investments aligned with the frequency of the net asset value determination?
Feedback Report §3.1.3 (Valuation frequency of investments of the UCIs); CDR 231/2013 Art. 74
Is there a documented procedure ensuring that transactions on quoted and unquoted investments (including FDIs) concluded with related parties to the UCI are done on an arm's length basis?
Feedback Report §3.1.4 (Arm's length character of transactions)

For investments valued on the basis of prices/valuations obtained from a source which is not independent (e.g. issuer-provided prices for structured products): are cross-checks or reasonableness tests performed to ensure a reliable, independent valuation?
Did the statutory auditor issue a modified audit opinion and/or raise management letter observations for this UCI in the reporting period?
Feedback Report §3.2 (Modified audit opinions and Management letter observations); Circular CSSF 21/790 §2.2
Which accounting standard does the UCI apply for the preparation of its annual report?

Has a specific, documented assessment of market timing risk been performed for each active sub-fund — upon launch or upon material changes to its exposure profile — beyond general coverage of the risk in the prospectus?

Does the UCI have a documented internal policy/procedure for each Liquidity Management Tool available to it (anti-dilution levy, swing pricing, lock-up, redemption gating, redemption deferral, redemption in kind, side pocket, dual pricing, temporary suspension)?

Is there a formalised assessment verifying that costs/fees — together with the level of ORC/TER of the UCI's different share classes — are proportionate to market standards, discussed at least annually in a formal meeting of the dirigeants?
Feedback Report §5.1 (ORC/TER and formalised assessment of costs/fees)
For UCITS concluding EPM/SFT transactions: is there a comprehensive, documented assessment justifying the ratio of gross revenues to direct and indirect operational costs/fees arising per EPM/SFT?
Feedback Report §5.2 (EPM/SFT operational costs/fees); CSSF FAQ — Use of SFTs by UCITS
Are robust processes in place with the depositary (reconciliation and safekeeping of assets, cash-flow monitoring) and an active process to follow up on irregularities escalated by the depositary?

Does the annual report comply with applicable disclosure requirements — SFDR Article 8/9 Annex IV (including the fossil gas/nuclear energy question), ESMA performance fee disclosure guidelines at share-class level, and securities financing transactions disclosures — where applicable to this UCI?
Summary: UCITS (Part I of the UCI Law)
